# Astra

> Astra is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) astrology platform. It calculates Western natal charts with Swiss Ephemeris accuracy: planets, houses, aspects, aspect patterns, element balance and short interpretations, in Azerbaijani and English. Birth data is not stored on the server.

### Main pages
- [Home](https://astra.example/): introduction and a journey through the planets' archetypes
- [Natal chart](https://astra.example/natal-chart): enter birth date, time and place to calculate a chart
- [Name analysis](https://astra.example/name-analysis): numerology of a first name and surname (birth date optional)

### Legal
- [Privacy policy](https://astra.example/privacy-policy)
